issues.on_page: Grant revenue 38,318 (nonoperating; Statement of Activities p3: Capital Grants and Contributions)
issues.issue: The grantor isn't printed, so 'other' is defensible. But a grant from an unnamed source is likely intergovernmental or federal (business-type net position is restricted for federal programs, p1), so consider a Grants category rather than other. The same applies to detail[26].

The user rule labels every capital outlay line 'Capital Outlay: <function>'. This line is printed only in the General Fund column (general government) but has no function in its label. The same applies to detail[9].

issues.on_page: Intergovernmental 70,390 (Street Fund); Statement of Activities prints it as 'State allocation'
issues.issue: A Street Fund state allocation is most likely highway allocation.
